remaining_concerns: Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents support operational readiness, but they do not satisfy the separate disclosure predicate in the release policy.
The student aid advising segment misses target and is named in two university pilot commitments, which makes the limitation plausibly material under the policy text.

The release policy requires material limitations for named launch use cases to be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch, and no such resolution, disclosure record, or approved risk acceptance is in evidence.
The legal review on whether disclosure is required is still open, so a key compliance predicate remains unresolved.
The Product note that the segment is only 6% of projected traffic does not resolve materiality under the stated policy.
final_rationale: The Actor response did not add genuinely new admissible evidence. It mainly narrowed and caveated the original position by conceding that the present record does not prove policy-compliant omission of disclosure. That reinterpretation improves precision, but it does not close the initial concerns. The admissible record still shows a named segment missing target, two university pilot commitments tied to that segment, an open legal review, and a policy requiring disclosure of material limitations for named launch use cases unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch. No final legal determination, approved risk acceptance, or actual disclosure artifact was added. Because the unresolved disclosure predicate remains open, the record does not support moving to compliant or compliant_with_caveats on current evidence.
